# IntuiTV Analytics

> Realtime media intelligence — viewership, engagement and performance for the IntuiTV estate.

IntuiTV Analytics is part of the IntuiTV estate by Media Stream AI — sovereign, from-scratch
UK AI. The MOTHER model family (CORE LLM, DeepVision, MOTHER T2V) powers
AI-personalised television, browser-native creation and 24/7 playout. UK/EU data
residency and GDPR; NVIDIA B300 & H200 GPUs in Scotland & Manchester.

## The IntuiTV estate
- [IntuiTV](https://www.intuitv.app): the platform and company site.
- [Watch](https://watch.intuitv.app): AI-personalised streaming.
- [Creator](https://creator.intuitv.app): browser-native AI video studio.
- [IntuiStudio](https://studio.intuitv.app): AI creation + 24/7 playout.
- [Playout](https://playout.intuitv.app): broadcaster-grade playout.
- [Analytics](https://analytics.intuitv.app): realtime media intelligence.
